title: Design System: DSH Waycraft native settings

narrative.overview: The Owner pinned DSH's existing settings language. This minimal source-backed record preserves that authority; it is not a new brand, a pixel-parity claim or a certification of the current mixed layouts.
dos: Do inherit host theme, controls, keyboard behavior and layout discipline.
Do retain explicit labels, disabled/busy/error states and focus restoration.
donts: Don't style or replace native Settings > Models.
Don't treat API key presence as service health, missing metadata as a missing key, DeepSeek Account as an API-key row, or unavailable usage as zero.
Don't create a second visual brand or fabricated quotas.
